notes: «حدثنا أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation (rule 7); «أخيه علي بن مهزيار» is one link with the name alone

rule 11: the Imam Abu Abdullah appears in the scene Marrah narrates and speaks and acts there («ثم قال هكذا صنع رسول الله»); he is not added as a link, and whether he is a source of the report needs a ruling
the saying is Marrah's account: he is the last link
